verses.pali: “Dvinnaṁ, bhikkhave, puggalānaṁ kālakiriyā bahuno janassa anutappā hoti.
verses.english: “There are two individuals, mendicants, whose death is regretted by many people.

verses.pali: Tathāgatassa ca arahato sammāsambuddhassa, rañño ca cakkavattissa.
verses.english: The Realized One, the perfected one, the fully awakened Buddha; and the wheel-turning monarch.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṁ puggalānaṁ kālakiriyā bahuno janassa anutappā hotī”ti.
verses.english: These are the two individuals, mendicants, whose death is regretted by many people.”
